title: LlmClaim
description: One behavioral claim produced by the interpretation pass. Validated with ajv before it touches the pipeline; invalid objects are discarded.

statement.description: One sentence stating the observed behavior, including the concrete HTTP status.

endpoint.description: Endpoint label exactly as given in the trial summary, e.g. "GET /v1/forecast".

kind.description: undocumented_constraint = a rule the API enforces that the spec never states (parameters that must be sent together, implicit defaults, orderings). It is NOT a contradiction of the spec; keep diverges_from_spec=false for it.

param.description: The parameter the claim is about, or null for endpoint-level behavior.

verdict.description: accepts = the API accepted the probed input; rejects = it refused it; observes = a neutral observation.

status.description: The HTTP status that trial showed. Must match the summary exactly.

spec_says.description: What the spec claims about this, if the claim diverges from it.
